verdict.rationale: Fellow records and transcribes calls, so clipping and sharing a moment is a fair axis for this product. However, the evidence pack documents no clip, soundbite or highlight-reel feature, and no way to share part of a recording. The only related items are timestamped transcripts and 'highlights' in Fellow Markdown note content, which are adjacent text features, not cutting or sharing a clip of the call.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can cut a soundbite or highlight clip from a call and share that moment instead of the whole recording
